## Data Source

<https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/download_files.html#Daily>

## Raw Data

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

graphics.off()   # close any small R Graphics window

base <- "data/OZONE"   # relative to this file; see README for how to get the data

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. DATA: read the zips, keep only the city of Dallas
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
zips <- list.files(base, pattern = "^daily_44201_\\d{4}\\.zip$",
                   recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
cat("Zip files found:", length(zips), "\n")

read_dallas_county <- function(z) {
  tmp <- tempfile(); dir.create(tmp); on.exit(unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE))
  unzip(z, exdir = tmp)
  csv <- list.files(tmp, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)[1]
  d <- fread(csv, colClasses = "character")
  out <- d[suppressWarnings(as.integer(`State Code`)) == 48 &
             suppressWarnings(as.integer(`County Code`)) == 113]
  cat("done:", basename(z), "-", nrow(out), "rows\n")
  out
}

county <- rbindlist(lapply(zips, read_dallas_county), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

# City of Dallas: sites ever labeled "Dallas", keeping all their rows
# (recovers early years where City Name is blank)
dallas_sites <- unique(county[trimws(`City Name`) == "Dallas", `Site Num`])
dallas <- county[`Site Num` %in% dallas_sites]

dallas[, `Date Local`    := as.Date(`Date Local`)]
dallas[, `1st Max Value` := as.numeric(`1st Max Value`)]
dallas[, Year  := year(`Date Local`)]
dallas[, Month := month(`Date Local`)]

cat("\nTotal rows (city of Dallas):", format(nrow(dallas), big.mark = ","), "\n")
print(dallas[, .N, by = .(`Site Num`, `Local Site Name`, `City Name`)][order(`Site Num`)])
print(dallas[, .N, by = `Sample Duration`])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CHART: daily maximum 1-hour ozone
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
d <- dallas[grepl("1.?HOUR", `Sample Duration`, ignore.case = TRUE)]
if (nrow(d) == 0) d <- dallas

ts <- d[, .(max_1h = max(`1st Max Value`, na.rm = TRUE)), by = `Date Local`]
ts <- ts[is.finite(max_1h)][order(`Date Local`)]

p <- ggplot(ts, aes(`Date Local`, max_1h)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.2, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Dallas daily maximum 1-hour ozone, 1980-2026",
       x = "Date", y = "Ozone (ppm)") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. TABLE: observations per month per year
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
dallas[, MonthName := factor(month.abb[Month], levels = month.abb)]

# (a) Raw rows
rows_tbl <- dcast(dallas[, .N, by = .(Year, MonthName)],
                  Year ~ MonthName, value.var = "N", fill = 0, drop = FALSE)
rows_tbl[, Total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = month.abb]

# (b) Unique monitor-days (one per site + POC + date, duplicates from
#     multiple pollutant standards removed)
md <- unique(dallas[, .(Year, MonthName, `Site Num`, POC, `Date Local`)])
md_tbl <- dcast(md[, .N, by = .(Year, MonthName)],
                Year ~ MonthName, value.var = "N", fill = 0, drop = FALSE)
md_tbl[, Total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = month.abb]

options(width = 200)
cat("\n--- (a) Raw rows per month and year ---\n")
print(rows_tbl, nrows = 100)
cat("\n--- (b) Unique monitor-days per month and year ---\n")
print(md_tbl, nrows = 100)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. TABLE: observations frequency per day
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# Observations per day (unique monitor-days: one per site + POC + date,
# so duplicates from multiple pollutant standards are not counted twice)
md <- unique(dallas[, .(`Site Num`, POC, `Date Local`)])
obs_day <- md[, .(n_obs = .N), by = `Date Local`]
obs_day[, Year := year(`Date Local`)]

# 1. Frequency chart: how many days have n observations
freq <- obs_day[, .(days = .N), by = n_obs][order(n_obs)]
print(freq)

p1 <- ggplot(freq, aes(factor(n_obs), days)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = days), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Dallas ozone: frequency of observations per day, 1980-2026",
       x = "Number of observations in a day (monitor records)",
       y = "Number of days") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p1)

# 2. Same chart split by decade, to show how coverage changed
obs_day[, Decade := paste0(floor(Year / 10) * 10, "s")]
freq_dec <- obs_day[, .(days = .N), by = .(Decade, n_obs)]

p2 <- ggplot(freq_dec, aes(factor(n_obs), days)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ Decade, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Frequency of observations per day, by decade",
       x = "Number of observations in a day", y = "Number of days") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p2)
```

## Data Cleaning 1: Average

```{r}

# ---- Data: one observation per day (average across monitors) ----
dallas[, `Observation Percent` := as.numeric(`Observation Percent`)]

clean <- unique(dallas, by = c("Site Num", "POC", "Date Local"))        # one row per monitor-day
clean <- clean[`Observation Percent` >= 75 & !is.na(`1st Max Value`)]   # valid days only

daily <- clean[, .(ozone = mean(`1st Max Value`), n_monitors = .N),
               by = .(`Date Local`, Year, Month)][order(`Date Local`)]

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(daily$`Date Local`))   # each date exactly once

cat("Days with data:", format(nrow(daily), big.mark = ","), "\n")

# ---- Table: observations per month per year (new data, one per day) ----
daily[, MonthName := factor(month.abb[Month], levels = month.abb)]

daily_tbl <- dcast(daily[, .N, by = .(Year, MonthName)],
                   Year ~ MonthName, value.var = "N", fill = 0, drop = FALSE)
daily_tbl[, Total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = month.abb]

options(width = 200)
cat("\n--- Observations (days with data) per month and year ---\n")
print(daily_tbl, nrows = 100)

# ---- Time series chart ----
p_ts <- ggplot(daily, aes(`Date Local`, ozone)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.2, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "5 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "Dallas daily maximum 8-hour ozone (average of monitors), 1980-2026",
       x = "Date", y = "Ozone (ppm)") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_ts)
```

## Trends Review

```{r}

yl <- range(daily$ozone)   # same y-axis for every chart

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# A. One chart per year (1980, 1981, ... 2026)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
years <- sort(unique(daily$Year))

plots_year <- lapply(years, function(y) {
  ggplot(daily[Year == y], aes(`Date Local`, ozone)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = yl) +
    labs(title = paste("Dallas daily maximum 8-hour ozone,", y),
         x = NULL, y = "Ozone (ppm)") +
    theme_minimal()
})
names(plots_year) <- years

for (p in plots_year) print(p)      # use the arrows in the Plots tab to move between them
# plots_year[["1985"]]              # to show a single year
```

```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# B. One chart per month, with every year side by side
#    (Jan 1980, Jan 1981, ... Jan 2026; then Feb, and so on)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

plots_month <- lapply(1:12, function(m) {
  ggplot(daily[Month == m], aes(mday(`Date Local`), ozone, group = Year, color = Year)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", end = 0.9) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 31, by = 5)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = range(daily$ozone)) +
    labs(title = paste("Dallas daily maximum 8-hour ozone,", month.name[m], "1980-2026"),
         x = "Day of month", y = "Ozone (ppm)", color = "Year") +
    theme_minimal()
})
names(plots_month) <- month.abb

for (p in plots_month) print(p)    # use the arrows in the Plots tab
# plots_month[["Jul"]]             # to show a single month
```
